_schema.CALENDAR_NAME_PREFIX: string (required) - prefix of the calendar this spec creates; contains spaces so every path is percent-encoded; a run id is appended
_schema.CYCLES: object[] (required) - three cycles sent on create, deliberately not in startDate order
_schema.OLDER_CALENDAR_NAME: string (required) - long-standing seeded calendar; the new calendar must be listed before it (createdOn DESC)
_schema.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE: number (required) - page size of both listings when pageSize is omitted
_schema.LIST_PAGE_SIZE: number (required) - page size used to walk the calendar list
_schema.ALL_ROWS_PAGE_SIZE: number (required) - page size large enough to return every calendar
_schema.UNKNOWN_CALENDAR_NAME: string (required) - calendar name that does not exist
_schema.INVALID_ARGUMENT_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a pageSize or pageNumber PageRequest rejects

DESCRIPTION: Playwright calendar and cycle listing test
